top_text: King Peleus who is a mortal , while you are yourselves ageless and immortal
mighty Iphitus the son of Naubolus
noble son of Peires , who had come from fertile Thrace
god of the Pelasgi , who dwellest afar , you who hold wintry Dodona
son of Borus the Meonian , who had come from Varne
First Adrestus , Autonous , Echeclus , Perimus the son of Megas , Epistor and Melanippus
